contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ FEL TEMP[REPARATIO] ; D/ D N [...] VS NOB CAES

An incomplete copper-alloy nummus probably of Constantius Gallus, AD351-354. AD351-355, (Reece period 18). Reverse legend reads FEL TEMP[REPARATIO]. Reverse shows Soldier advancing left, spearing fallen horseman. Mint is probably Constantinople. See RIC VIII, p.458, c.f.120. Obverse shows Bare-headed, draped and cuirassed bust right.
